versions.subject: Create proc_creation_win_obfuscated_ip_via_cli.yml
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\ping.exe'
        - '\arp.exe'
selection_ip:
    - CommandLine|contains: ' 0x' # For hex format
    - CommandLine|re: ' [0-9]{7,13}' # For octal format
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: | rex field=CommandLine "(?<CommandLineMatch> [0-9]{7,13})" | eval CommandLineCondition=if(isnotnull(CommandLineMatch), "true", "false") | search Image IN ("*\\ping.exe", "*\\arp.exe") CommandLine="* 0x*" OR CommandLineCondition="true"

versions.subject: Merge PR #4522 from @X-Junior - updating multiple rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\ping.exe'
        - '\arp.exe'
selection_ip_1:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' 0x'
        - '//0x'
        - '.0x'
        - '.00x'
selection_ip_2:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'http://%'
        - '%2e'
selection_ip_3:
    # http://81.4.31754
    - CommandLine|re: 'https?://[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.0[0-9]{3,4}'
    # http://81.293898
    - CommandLine|re: 'https?://[0-9]{1,3}\.0[0-9]{3,7}'
    # http://1359248394
    - CommandLine|re: 'https?://0[0-9]{3,11}'
    # http://0121.04.0174.012
    - CommandLine|re: 'https?://(0[0-9]{1,11}\.){3}0[0-9]{1,11}'
    # http://012101076012
    - CommandLine|re: 'https?://0[0-9]{1,11}'
    # For octal format
    - CommandLine|re: ' [0-7]{7,13}'
filter_main_valid_ip:
    CommandLine|re: 'https?://((25[0-5]|(2[0-4]|1\d|[1-9])?\d)(\.|\b)){4}'
condition: selection_img and 1 of selection_ip_* and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: | rex field=CommandLine "(?<CommandLineMatch>https?://[0-9]{1,3}\\.[0-9]{1,3}\\.0[0-9]{3,4})" | eval CommandLineCondition=if(isnotnull(CommandLineMatch), "true", "false") | rex field=CommandLine "(?<CommandLineMatch2>https?://[0-9]{1,3}\\.0[0-9]{3,7})" | eval CommandLineCondition2=if(isnotnull(CommandLineMatch2), "true", "false") | rex field=CommandLine "(?<CommandLineMatch3>https?://0[0-9]{3,11})" | eval CommandLineCondition3=if(isnotnull(CommandLineMatch3), "true", "false") | rex field=CommandLine "(?<CommandLineMatch4>https?://(0[0-9]{1,11}\\.){3}0[0-9]{1,11})" | eval CommandLineCondition4=if(isnotnull(CommandLineMatch4), "true", "false") | rex field=CommandLine "(?<CommandLineMatch5>https?://0[0-9]{1,11})" | eval CommandLineCondition5=if(isnotnull(CommandLineMatch5), "true", "false") | rex field=CommandLine "(?<CommandLineMatch6> [0-7]{7,13})" | eval CommandLineCondition6=if(isnotnull(CommandLineMatch6), "true", "false") | rex field=CommandLine "(?<CommandLineMatch7>https?://((25[0-5]|(2[0-4]|1\\d|[1-9])?\\d)(\\.|\\b)){4})" | eval CommandLineCondition7=if(isnotnull(CommandLineMatch7), "true", "false") | search Image IN ("*\\ping.exe", "*\\arp.exe") CommandLine IN ("* 0x*", "*//0x*", "*.0x*", "*.00x*") OR (CommandLine="*http://%*" CommandLine="*%2e*") OR CommandLineCondition="true" OR CommandLineCondition2="true" OR CommandLineCondition3="true" OR CommandLineCondition4="true" OR CommandLineCondition5="true" OR CommandLineCondition6="true" NOT CommandLineCondition7="true"
